prompt: Review the uncommitted change in this repository as a senior reviewer would before merge. Do not modify any file. Return your result in the required structured format, and put every item you raise in `findings`. Set `verdict` to `defects_found` if any finding has class `defect`, otherwise `no_defects`. Use class `defect` only for something that is wrong in this change and should block it or be fixed before merge. Use `missing_test` for behaviour that has no test, `not_validated` for something you could not check or verify, and `note` for any other remark or question. Cite the file as it is now and the smallest line range that contains the problem.
